cards.english_title: Andhra Polls Bring Clashes and Uneven Turnout
cards.korean_desc: 안드라프라데시가 2026년 11월 1일 지방선거를 열었다. 오전 11시 투표율은 22.08%였고 잠말라마두구는 60.92%였다. 당국은 대부분 평화롭지만 공정성 논란은 남았다고 말했다. 2026년 11월 3일 개표한다.
cards.english_desc: Andhra Pradesh held urban local elections on November 1, 2026. By 11 a.m., state turnout was 22.08 percent, while Jammalamadugu reached 60.92 percent. Officials said the rest of the state was largely peaceful, but claims about fairness remained disputed. Votes will be counted on November 3, 2026.
cards.hook: Andhra polls saw clashes, while towns voted faster.
cards.takeaway_english: The November 3 count will show whether turnout or conflict shapes the political message.

why_it_matters.korean: 도시와 작은 마을의 투표 참여가 달랐다.

cards.english_title: India’s GST Collections Cross ₹2.31 Lakh Crore
cards.korean_desc: 인도는 2026년 10월 GST 총액 2.31 lakh crore를 넘겼다. 증가는 국내 판매와 수입에서 나왔다. 국내 GST는 16%, 수입 세수는 42% 올랐다.
cards.english_desc: India collected over ₹2.31 lakh crore in gross GST during October 2026. The increase came from domestic sales and imports. Domestic GST rose 16 percent, while import revenue climbed 42 percent.
cards.takeaway_english: The next monthly figures will show whether October’s jump continues.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 달 수치가 증가세 지속 여부를 보여줄 것이다.

why_it_matters.english: Tax collections help fund public spending and government services.
why_it_matters.korean: 세수는 공공 지출과 정부 서비스를 돕는다.

why_it_matters.english: The figures also show how much economic activity is being taxed.
why_it_matters.korean: 수치는 과세되는 경제 활동의 규모도 보여준다.

parties.label: Government
parties.english: It reported stronger GST collections from domestic activity and imports.
parties.korean: 정부는 국내 활동과 수입 증가를 보고했다.

parties.label: Businesses and consumers
parties.english: Their taxable purchases and sales helped produce the monthly total.
parties.korean: 과세 대상 거래가 월간 총액을 만들었다.

views.label: Government data
views.english: The figures point to stronger domestic activity and imports.
views.korean: 수치는 국내 활동과 수입 증가를 보여준다.

views.label: A cautious reading
views.english: Gross collections alone do not show how much money remains after refunds.
views.korean: 총액만으로는 환급 뒤 남은 돈을 알 수 없다.

disagree.english: Some readers may see the rise as growth, while others may focus on refunds and import dependence.
disagree.korean: 일부는 성장을 보지만 다른 사람은 환급과 수입을 본다.

cards.english_title: Vikram Goyal Turns Ramayana Creatures into Design
cards.korean_desc: 디자이너 비크람 고얄은 2026년 10월 런던에서 작품을 선보였다. 작품에는 황동, 브로케이드, 자수, 러그와 자개가 쓰였다. 이 프로젝트는 고대 이야기를 현대 디자인에 계속 담는다.
cards.english_desc: Designer Vikram Goyal presented Wings and Tales in London from October 12 to 16, 2026. The collection combines brass, brocade, embroidery, rugs and mother-of-pearl. The project keeps testing how ancient stories can live inside contemporary design.
cards.hook: Vikram Goyal brings Ramayana creatures into modern design.
cards.takeaway_english: Goyal’s collection suggests that old myths can travel through materials, rooms and new audiences.
cards.takeaway_korean: 고얄의 작품은 신화가 새 공간으로 이동함을 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: The project connects ancient storytelling with furniture, textiles and homes.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 작품은 고대 이야기와 가구와 집을 연결한다.

why_it_matters.english: It gives less-famous Ramayana figures a new place in public attention.
why_it_matters.korean: 덜 알려진 라마야나 인물들이 새 주목을 받는다.

parties.label: Vikram Goyal
parties.english: The designer made Wings and Tales from Ramayana creatures, landscapes and themes.
parties.korean: 고얄은 라마야나 동물과 풍경으로 작품을 만들었다.

parties.label: London exhibition
parties.english: The collection appeared in a Georgian townhouse in Mayfair from October 12 to 16, 2026.

views.label: Goyal’s approach
views.english: The less-famous creatures carry ideas about sacrifice, loyalty, friendship and spiritual meaning.
views.korean: 덜 알려진 동물도 희생과 충성을 보여준다.

views.label: A broader design view
views.english: The collection shows Indian craft as a living language in contemporary design.
views.korean: 이 작품은 인도 공예를 현대 언어로 보여준다.

disagree.english: Some viewers may prefer religious figures shown directly, while Goyal chooses supporting creatures and landscapes.
disagree.korean: 일부 관객은 주인공을 원하지만 고얄은 주변 동물을 택했다.

cards.english_title: New Zealand Fields First in Final T20I
cards.korean_desc: 뉴질랜드는 2026년 11월 1일 해밀턴에서 인도에 맞서 토스를 이겼다. 뉴질랜드는 매슈 피셔 대신 블레어 틱너를 넣었다. 주장 미첼 산터는 다섯 번째 최종 T20I에서 선공을 골랐다. 인도는 부브네슈와르를 돌아오게 하고 바룬에게 첫 기회를 줬다.

Captain Mitchell Santner chose to field first in the fifth and final T20I. India brought back Bhuvneshwar Kumar and gave Varun Chakravarthy his tour debut.
cards.hook: New Zealand won the toss and chose to field.
cards.takeaway_english: The final result will show whether New Zealand’s bowling-first plan worked.
cards.takeaway_korean: 최종 결과가 뉴질랜드 전략의 성공을 보여줄 것이다.

why_it_matters.english: Team changes gave players a final chance to influence the series.
why_it_matters.korean: 선수 교체는 시리즈에 영향을 줄 마지막 기회였다.

parties.label: India

parties.label: Varun Chakravarthy
parties.english: He played his first match of the tour.
parties.korean: 바룬 차크라바르티가 투어 첫 경기를 했다.

views.korean: 산터는 최종전에서 먼저 투구하는 쪽을 택했다.

cards.english_title: Ajay Devgn Challenges Vimal Elaichi Notice
cards.korean_desc: FDA는 카다멈 제품이 판 마살라를 홍보했다고 주장했다. 데브건은 제조사가 아닌 배우인 자신에게 통지가 왔다고 말했다. 봄베이 고등법원은 2026년 11월 4일 심리할 수 있다.
cards.english_desc: The FDA alleged that the ad promoted Vimal Pan Masala through a cardamom product. Devgn says the notice was served on him as an actor, not on the manufacturer. The Bombay High Court may hear the petition on November 4, 2026.
cards.hook: Ajay Devgn challenged an FDA notice in court.
cards.takeaway_english: The Bombay High Court may hear Devgn’s petition on November 4, 2026.

why_it_matters.english: The case tests how food-safety rules apply to celebrity advertising.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 사건은 식품안전 규정의 광고 적용을 시험한다.

why_it_matters.english: The decision could affect actors, brands and viewers of surrogate advertising.
why_it_matters.korean: 결정은 배우와 브랜드와 광고 시청자에게 영향을 줄 수 있다.

parties.label: Ajay Devgn
parties.english: He asked the Bombay High Court to examine the FDA notice against him.
parties.korean: 그는 봄베이 고등법원에 FDA 통지를 다뤄 달라고 했다.

parties.label: Maharashtra FDA
parties.english: The department said the advertisement promoted Vimal Pan Masala through Vimal Elaichi.
parties.korean: FDA는 광고가 판 마살라를 홍보했다고 말했다.

parties.label: Other actors
parties.english: Shah Rukh Khan and Tiger Shroff also received notices in August.
parties.korean: 샤룩 칸과 타이거 슈로프도 8월 통지를 받았다.

views.label: Ajay Devgn
views.english: He says the notice targeted him as an actor, not the manufacturer, and says he no longer represents the brand.
views.korean: 그는 배우인 자신만 겨냥했고 이제 브랜드와 무관하다고 말한다.

views.label: Maharashtra FDA
views.english: The department says the matter should proceed before the Joint Commissioner.
views.korean: FDA는 사건이 합동위원회에서 계속돼야 한다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The court must still consider whether the notice and the challenged regulations apply to Devgn.
disagree.korean: 법원은 통지와 규정이 데브건에게 적용되는지 판단해야 한다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 연예인은 광고 제품 때문에 법적 책임을 져야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Israeli Protesters Push Opposition Toward Arab Allies
cards.korean_desc: 아랍계 정당은 19석을 얻어 반네타냐후 연대가 67석이 될 수 있다. 선거 뒤 네타냐후 진영은 53석, 야권은 48석이었다. 가디 아이젠코트는 결정하지 않았고 리베르만은 연대를 거부했다. 이츠하크 헤르초그 대통령은 정부 구성자를 지명할 예정이다.
cards.english_desc: Arab-majority parties won 19 seats, potentially giving an anti-Netanyahu alliance 67 seats. The election left Netanyahu’s bloc with 53 seats and the opposition bloc with 48. Gadi Eisenkot has not decided, while Avigdor Liberman rejects a coalition relying on Arab parties. President Isaac Herzog is expected to assign a leader to form a government.
cards.hook: Protesters want Arab parties to help remove Netanyahu.
cards.takeaway_english: The key question is whether political arithmetic can overcome deep disagreement over identity and security.
cards.takeaway_korean: 정치적 숫자가 정체성과 안보 갈등을 넘을지가 핵심이다.

why_it_matters.english: The coalition choice could determine Israel’s next government after an inconclusive election.
why_it_matters.korean: 연대 선택이 불완전한 선거 뒤 새 정부를 정할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: It also tests Arab citizens’ place in national political power.
why_it_matters.korean: 이는 아랍 시민의 정치 참여도 시험한다.

parties.label: Opposition bloc
parties.english: It won 48 seats and needs Arab-party support to reach a majority.
parties.korean: 야권은 48석을 얻어 아랍 정당 지원이 필요하다.

parties.label: Arab parties
parties.english: Raam and the Joint List won 19 seats together.

parties.label: Netanyahu bloc
parties.english: The bloc won 53 seats and warned against relying on Arab parties.

views.label: Protesters
views.english: They argue Jewish and Arab parties must work together because the numbers allow a 67-seat majority.
views.korean: 시위대는 숫자상 67석 다수가 가능해 함께해야 한다고 말한다.

views.label: Avigdor Liberman
views.english: He says his party will not join a coalition relying on Arab parties, even externally.
views.korean: 리베르만은 아랍 정당 의존 연정에 참여하지 않겠다고 말했다.

disagree.english: Supporters say cooperation enables change, while opponents question security positions and political trust.
disagree.korean: 찬성자는 변화를 말하지만 반대자는 안보와 신뢰를 의심한다.

views.english: They say excluding Arab parties would block a possible majority for change.

caption_lines: Israel’s parliament has 120 seats; 61 are needed for a majority.
President Isaac Herzog is expected to give a leader a mandate to form a government.
cards.reader_question: Should a coalition include parties from a community long kept outside government?

sources.title: Israeli protesters demand opposition ally with Arab parties to oust Netanyahu

sentences.english: Arab-majority parties won 19 seats, potentially giving an anti-Netanyahu alliance 67 seats.
sentences.korean: 아랍계 정당은 19석을 얻어 반네타냐후 연대가 67석이 될 수 있다.

sentences.english: The election left Netanyahu’s bloc with 53 seats and the opposition bloc with 48.
sentences.korean: 선거 뒤 네타냐후 진영은 53석, 야권은 48석이었다.

sentences.english: Gadi Eisenkot has not decided, while Avigdor Liberman rejects a coalition relying on Arab parties.
sentences.korean: 가디 아이젠코트는 결정하지 않았고 리베르만은 연대를 거부했다.

sentences.english: President Isaac Herzog is expected to assign a leader to form a government.
sentences.korean: 이츠하크 헤르초그 대통령은 정부 구성자를 지명할 예정이다.
